description: Empirical harvested-power vs base-acceleration lookup for a PZT-5A bimorph cantilever at resonance (100 Hz) into an impedance-matched load. At resonance P scales with acceleration^2; anchored at 0.5 mW for 1 g (9.81 m/s^2).
source: Roundy et al. (2003) Smart Mater. Struct.; Erturk & Inman (2011) Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting

resonance_freq_hz.note: First resonance frequency (reused from EC219 F1a)

P_ref_mW.note: Reference power at 1 g base acceleration

lookup.note: Breakpoints: base acceleration (m/s^2) -> harvested power (mW) at resonance, matched load

power_mW.note: Rated 0.5 mW at 1 g, 100 Hz for PZT-5A bimorph
